# SolarMatch Thailand

SolarMatch Thailand is a bilingual residential-solar assessment and lead-qualification service for homeowners in Thailand.

Canonical public routes:
- Thai home: https://solarmatch-thailand.deluxejahseh.workers.dev/
- English home: https://solarmatch-thailand.deluxejahseh.workers.dev/en
- Thai assessment: https://solarmatch-thailand.deluxejahseh.workers.dev/estimate
- English assessment: https://solarmatch-thailand.deluxejahseh.workers.dev/en/estimate
- Thai methodology: https://solarmatch-thailand.deluxejahseh.workers.dev/methodology
- English methodology: https://solarmatch-thailand.deluxejahseh.workers.dev/en/methodology
- Thai Privacy Notice: https://solarmatch-thailand.deluxejahseh.workers.dev/privacy
- English Privacy Notice: https://solarmatch-thailand.deluxejahseh.workers.dev/en/privacy

Important limitations:
- Results are preliminary estimates, not engineering designs, quotations, or guarantees.
- Actual suitability and savings require a site assessment and depend on usage, roof conditions, equipment, design, price, and tariffs.
- SolarMatch is not the installer and may be paid by a receiving solar company for a referral made with the user’s consent.
- The contact form remains disabled until the legal operator, privacy contact, receiving company, and retention period are completely published.
- There are no payments, customer accounts, multi-installer bidding, advertising, analytics, CRM, or automated buyer routing.
- Public pages are marked noindex during the limited validation stage.

This file is descriptive only. It is not an access-control or security policy.
